name: Perturbation-target prediction from attention-derived edge scores (Kendiukhov 2026, Objective B)
description: For each CRISPR perturbation, score every other gene by an edge score to the perturbed gene (attention, Spearman correlation) or by a gene-level statistic (variance, mean expression, dropout rate), and measure AUROC for classifying the differentially expressed targets. Incremental-value tests add edge scores to a gene-level logistic regression.

attributes.task: Predict which genes are differentially expressed after a CRISPRi or CRISPRa perturbation
attributes.scope_note: Replogle genome-scale CRISPRi (K562, RPE1) and a K562 CRISPRa dataset; T cell and iPSC neuron sets have n = 7 perturbations and print no AUROC values.
attributes.source_locator: Pages 4 and 7-10, 'Results'; pages 13-14, 'Methods'

name: Systematic evaluation of single-cell foundation model interpretability: attention-derived edge scores add no incremental value over gene-level features for perturbation-target prediction (Kendiukhov 2026, BMC Genomics 27:634)
description: Publisher PDF of the article, retrieved and hashed for the 2026-10-14 genomic foundation model guide fixes (issue rewire-benchmark-data#129).

attributes.version: Version of record, BMC Genomics 27:634, published 2026-07-22 (received 2026-03-10, accepted 2026-05-14)
limitations: Single-author study; the author developed none of the evaluated foundation models but did develop CSSI and the evaluation framework.
Objective B results are printed in running text only; Figures 3, 4, 6 and 7 are not read.
Primary layer L13 was pre-specified on DLPFC brain data; L15 and L6 values come from an 18-layer profile (L15 selected by nested cross-validation).

evidence_concerns.message: The K562 CRISPRa analysis cites reference 25, Adamson et al. 2016 (Cell 167:1867), which is a CRISPRi Perturb-seq study of the unfolded protein response. The Data availability statement lists 'Dixit/Adamson/Shifrut datasets'. The CRISPRa dataset identity should be checked before the CRISPRa results are compared.
evidence_concerns.source_locator: Page 10, 'Context-dependent attention-correlation relationship', sentence 2 ('On K562 CRISPRa [25] (n = 77)'); reference 25; 'Data availability'

evidence_concerns.message: K562 CRISPRi results are reported on two perturbation sets: n = 151 for correlation edges and the gene-level baselines (Fig. 3) and n = 280 evaluable perturbations for the attention versus correlation comparison, where correlation scores 0.703 against 0.696 on the 151 set. The article does not say how the two sets relate. RPE1 is likewise reported at n = 1,251 (attention versus correlation) and n = 1,167 (confound battery), with attention 0.748 (L15) and 0.747 (layer not stated).
evidence_concerns.source_locator: Page 7, 'Perturbation-first validation reveals gene-level dominance', paragraphs 1-3; page 10, 'Context-dependent attention-correlation relationship' and 'Cross-cell-type generalisation of confound pattern'
